description: Agent Coordination: submit how a group of agents shares state: each shared record (a board, a file, a database, a document, a message thread, one agent’s own context or other) with its id, its name, its owner, the agents that write it and read it, the rule that settles two writes (one writer only, a lock, a versioned merge, the owner decides, the last write wins or no rule), what it keeps (a full change log, snapshots, the latest value only or nothing) and where a joining agent finds it; and optionally the agents in the group. The signed report lists every record with its writers, rule, history and whether a joining agent can rebuild it, counts the records with several, one or no writers and each rule, and names shared state that is unsafe: records with no named owner or writer, records several agents can overwrite with no conflict rule, and state a joining agent cannot reconstruct because it lives in one agent’s context, keeps nothing or has no location; then writers with no owner, last write wins, latest-value-only history and writers outside the group, with the fix for each. One agent’s view against the system record after an interruption is wever_state-reconciliation-check and partly done work in one task system is wever_partial-state-check. Verdict shared_state_unsafe, shared_state_gaps, shared_state_unverified or shared_state_sound. POST /api/coordination-state-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-coordination-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-coordination/.

agents.description: The agents in the group, to read writers against.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

history.description: What it keeps: a full change log with who and when, snapshots, the latest value only, or nothing.

kind.description: A board, a file, a database, a document, a message thread, one agent’s own context or other.

location.description: Where an agent joining the work finds it.

name.description: Such as the launch task board.

owner.description: The agent or person who owns the record.

write_rule.description: How two writes to the record are settled: one writer only, a lock, a versioned merge, the owner decides, the last write wins, or no rule.

writers.description: The agents that can write to it.
